about: Airport lounges and who gets in. Access tags: CO Capital One Lounge, CS Chase Sapphire Lounge, PP Priority Pass, AX Amex (Centurion; Sky Club when flying Delta), UA United Club, AA Admirals Club, AS Alaska Lounge, DL Delta Sky Club membership, AL airline ticket or status, PAY day pass sold. Entries with needsReview are unverified.

LAX.note: No Capital One or Chase lounge at LAX. Priority Pass options are limited to Gameway and the Virgin Clubhouse (fee).

BUR.note: No lounges listed. The new terminal opened Oct 13, 2026; check the airport's site for new amenities.

IAH.note: The Terminal B mezzanine United Club is temporarily closed.

ATL.note: No Capital One or Chase lounge at ATL.

CLT.note: A Capital One Lounge is announced for Concourse A but not open yet.

EYW.note: Key West has no airport lounges.

PBI.note: Access details here were last reported in 2020. Check before you go.

IAD.note: Both Lufthansa lounges in Concourse B are closed through 2026.

EWR.note: A Centurion Lounge is coming to Terminal A in 2026. The British Airways lounge is closed until summer 2027.

JFK.note: Delta flies from Terminal 4; lounges listed are in Terminal 4.

OPO.note: Here “ANA” is Portugal's airport operator, not the Japanese airline.

NRT.note: Singapore Airlines uses Terminal 1. Ask the airline which partner lounge business travelers use.

HND.note: ANA international flights use Terminal 3; ANA domestic flights (for example to Sapporo) normally leave from Terminal 2.

CTS.note: Flights to Tokyo Haneda are domestic. The North Lounge closed June 30, 2026.

BOI.note: No passenger lounge found at Boise.

BTR.note: No passenger lounge found at Baton Rouge.

BZN.note: No passenger lounge found at Bozeman.

BOS.note: A JetBlue BlueHouse is planned for Terminal C and a Centurion Lounge for 2029. No Capital One lounge.

DFW.note: A Chase Sapphire Lounge is coming to Terminal D near D35; check whether it has opened.

ORD.note: No Priority Pass, Capital One, Chase or Centurion lounge in United's Terminal 1.

AUS.note: The United Club is temporarily closed. No Priority Pass, Capital One or Chase lounge.

YYC.note: US flights leave from the transborder area (Concourse E).
